DRIVEWISE RENTALS
Sample Company Profile & Customer Information Guide
Note: DriveWise Rentals is a fictional company created for demonstration, chatbot/RAG testing, and project
documentation.
1. Company Overview
DriveWise Rentals is a fictional car rental company offering self-drive vehicles for city travel, business trips,
weekend journeys, and airport transfers. The company aims to provide transparent pricing, convenient
pickup locations, and straightforward booking support.

4. Booking Requirements

DriveWise Rentals | Sample / Fictional Information Page 2
• Customers must be at least 21 years old.
• Customers must hold a valid driving licence and provide accepted identification.
• For international licences, additional documentation may be required.
• A refundable security deposit may be required depending on the vehicle and booking.
• Bookings are subject to vehicle availability and confirmation.
5. Rental, Fuel & Mileage Rules
Rule Policy
Minimum rental Generally 24 hours; shorter rentals may be offered at selected locations.
Mileage allowance 250 km per day included unless the booking states otherwise.
Extra mileage n10 per km for economy/compact; n15 per km for premium/SUV. Confirmed in booking.
Fuel policy Return the vehicle with approximately the same fuel level as at pickup.

Fuel policy Return the vehicle with approximately the same fuel level as at pickup.
Late return A grace period of 60 minutes may apply. Additional charges can apply after that.
Vehicle use No racing, unlawful use, towing, or driving by unauthorized persons.
Outstation travel Permitted within approved areas; inform support if planning interstate travel.
6. Cancellation & Refund Policy
• Cancellation more than 24 hours before pickup: eligible for a full refund of the rental amount, excluding any
non-refundable payment processing fees if applicable.
• Cancellation within 24 hours of pickup: a cancellation fee of up to 50% of the rental amount may apply.
• No-show: may be treated as a late cancellation, with charges according to the booking terms.

• No-show: may be treated as a late cancellation, with charges according to the booking terms.
• Refund processing generally takes 5–7 business days after approval, depending on the payment provider.
• The specific booking confirmation and applicable terms take precedence over this general guide.
7. Damage, Accident & Roadside Support
In case of an accident, breakdown, or vehicle damage, customers should stop in a safe location, contact local
emergency services if needed, and call DriveWise support. Customers should not authorize repairs or admit
liability on behalf of the company without guidance, except where required for immediate safety.
Roadside support: +91 40 5555 0188 (fictional number; demo only).
8. Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Can I extend my booking?

8. Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Can I extend my booking?
A: Yes, subject to availability. Contact support before the scheduled return time. An extension is not
confirmed until approved.
Q: Can someone else drive the rental car?
A: Only drivers approved and documented on the booking may drive.
Q: Can I take the car outside Hyderabad?
A: Outstation travel may be allowed within approved areas. Confirm restrictions and charges before
departure.

DriveWise Rentals | Sample / Fictional Information Page 3
Q: Is the security deposit refundable?
A: Deposits are generally released after return inspection and settlement of any applicable charges.
Q: Can I book a specific model?
A: You may request a model, but availability may require a similar vehicle in the same category.
Q: What if I return the car late?
A: Contact support as early as possible. Late charges may apply beyond the grace period.
Q: How do I cancel?
A: Use the booking portal or contact support. Cancellation fees depend on the time of cancellation and
booking terms.
Q: What documents do I need?
A: A valid driving licence and accepted ID are generally required. Requirements may differ for international
customers.
